mapper.select: -- 인증명 기준 사용자 식별자를 조회한다. SELECT u.id FROM users u WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId}

-- 사용자의 현재 파트너 검증 상태를 조회한다. SELECT pv.status_code, pv.verified_at FROM partner_verifications pv WHERE pv.member_user_id = #{userId} AND pv.is_current = true ORDER BY pv.created_at DESC, pv.id DESC LIMIT 1

-- matching_cases 기준 진행 가능한 후보와 공고 기준 지원금액 범위를 집계한다. WITH candidate_cases AS ( SELECT mc.id, mc.announcement_id, mc.status_code FROM matching_cases mc WHERE mc.member_user_id = #{userId} AND mc.status_code IN ('MATCHED', 'REVIEW_REQUIRED', 'PROGRESSED') ) SELECT CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_options ao WHERE ao.announcement_id = cc.announcement_id AND ao.option_group_code = 'PAYMENT_METHOD' AND ao.option_code IN ('LOAN', 'GUARANTEE', 'INTEREST_SUPPORT') ) ) AS integer) AS policy_fund_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_options ao WHERE ao.announcement_id = cc.announcement_id AND ao.option_group_code = 'PAYMENT_METHOD' AND ao.option_code IN ('VOUCHER', 'POINT', 'GOODS', 'TAX_DEDUCTION') ) ) AS integer) AS support_fund_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_options ao WHERE ao.announcement_id = cc.announcement_id AND ao.option_group_code = 'PAYMENT_METHOD' AND ao.option_code IN ('CASH', 'REFUND') ) ) AS integer) AS subsidy_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE cc.status_code = 'MATCHED' ) AS integer) AS startable_matched_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE cc.status_code IN ('MATCHED', 'PROGRESSED') ) AS integer) AS final_matched_count, min(a.min_amount) AS min_amount, max(a.max_amount) AS max_amount FROM candidate_cases cc INNER JOIN announcements a ON a.id = cc.announcement_id

-- 사용자 신청 진행 상태와 확정 수령 금액을 집계한다. SELECT CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code IN ('READY', 'IN_PROGRESS') ) AS integer) AS in_progress_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'WAITING_RESULT' ) AS integer) AS waiting_result_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'APPROVED' ) AS integer) AS approved_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'SUPPLEMENT_REQUESTED' ) AS integer) AS supplement_requested_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'STOPPED' ) AS integer) AS stopped_count, COALESCE( sum( CASE WHEN ap.received_amount IS NOT NULL AND ( ap.status_code IN ('APPROVED', 'COMPLETED') OR ap.result_code = 'APPROVED' ) THEN ap.received_amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS total_received_amount FROM application_progresses ap WHERE ap.member_user_id = #{userId}

-- READY 또는 IN_PROGRESS 상태의 현재 처리 단계 1건을 조회한다. SELECT ap.id AS progress_id, step_state.status_code AS step_status_code, progress_step.step_name, progress_step.guide_message, progress_step.action_guide, ( SELECT step_button.button_label FROM announcement_step_buttons step_button WHERE step_button.step_id = step_state.step_id ORDER BY step_button.sort_order ASC, step_button.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS button_label, a.application_end_date AS due_date FROM application_step_states step_state INNER JOIN application_progresses ap ON ap.id = step_state.progress_id INNER JOIN announcement_progress_steps progress_step ON progress_step.id = step_state.step_id INNER JOIN announcements a ON a.id = ap.announcement_id WHERE ap.member_user_id = #{userId} AND step_state.status_code IN ('READY', 'IN_PROGRESS') ORDER BY CASE step_state.status_code WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'READY' THEN 2 ELSE 9 END ASC, COALESCE(step_state.started_at, step_state.created_at) ASC, progress_step.step_order ASC, step_state.id ASC LIMIT 1
